purpose: Teach: 変質/崇高/安堵/慰謝/感知/講ずる/発病/成就

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、長期入院で性格が変質する患者さんを医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Ren, when patients have extended hospital stays, their personalities can shift. Our medical team works to support them through that.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady pace. A gentle clarity—explaining something important without lecturing. Measured breath. Eye contact that says 'I'm telling you this because it matters.'

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療従事者の崇高な使命を医療チームで再確認します
lines.en: Yes. Our medical team takes that responsibility seriously—reminding ourselves of the profound duty we carry in this work.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Slight pause after 'Yes.' Thoughtful tone, almost to herself. The weight of meaning without heaviness. Voice settles, grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療完了時に患者さんが安堵される瞬間を、貴院、大事にされてますね、先生
lines.en: I've noticed your hospital really values that moment—when treatment ends and the patient can finally breathe. That means something, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely perceptive. Slight hesitation before 'breathe'—he's noticed something true and is offering it carefully. Warm but not presumptuous. Quiet reverence for the observation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療事故の慰謝制度を医療チームで整備します
lines.en: Yes. We've worked to build a comprehensive support system for patients—including protocols for accountability when things go wrong. It's part of the care.
lines.style: Measured response. The word 'accountability' lands with quiet weight. Professional but human. Not defensive—this is foundational to how she practices. Steady through-line.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 微細な体調変化を感知する機器を、貴院、導入されたんですね、先生
lines.en: I saw you've invested in equipment that catches the smallest changes in a patient's condition. That's not standard everywhere, is it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, almost amazed. Soft admiration underneath. Asking a real question, not flattering. Slight lean-in with interest. Respectful but engaged.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染対策を講ずる体制を医療チームで強化しました
lines.en: Yes. We've strengthened our infection prevention measures across the whole team. Prevention is always the goal—catching problems before they start.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. The confidence of someone who knows this work well. Not boastful—just clear about priorities. Breath is even. Authority that doesn't perform.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 発病前の予防医療を、貴院、推進されてますね、先生
lines.en: So preventive care before illness even appears—your hospital really does think ahead that way, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Soft observation, almost wondering aloud. Admiration that feels earned. A question that's also a recognition. Gentle, sincere, no performance. The slight lift of finding something true.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんの治療成就を医療チームで願っております
lines.en: Yes. That's what we hold onto—the hope that our team's work will help each patient find their way through to healing.
lines.style: Final statement, weighted with genuine feeling. Slower pace. Voice softens on 'healing.' Not weary, but carrying the accumulated weight of that hope. Quiet conviction that lands.
